[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended LED bulbs for the laundry room:

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Factors to consider when choosing an LED bulb: lumen output, color temperature, dimming capability, and certifications (Energy Star).  
[USER] The user is unsure about the difference between warm white and daylight color temperatures and which would be best for their laundry room.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Warm White (2700K-3000K): Soft, cozy, yellowish light, similar to traditional incandescent bulbs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Daylight (5000K-6500K): Bright, neutral, bluish light, similar to natural daylight, suitable for task areas like laundry rooms.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For a laundry room, a daylight bulb (5000K) is recommended for better visibility and energy.  
[USER] The user is considering whether LED bulbs are worth the extra cost compared to traditional incandescent bulbs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Benefits of LED bulbs:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Energy efficiency: Uses significantly less energy than incandescent bulbs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Longer lifespan: Lasts up to 25 times longer than incandescent bulbs.
